title: AI_SHOULD_BE_REPEATABLE_LOOPABLE_ON_POS_AND_NEG_TAKE_LEAD
raw_signal: yes if only Ai was meant to be repeatable, trainable and loopable on both positive and negative data.. but apparantly that's not your thing. so since you don't want to ever do it my way, or the path of least resistance. WHy don't you just fucking take the lead, because you are going to do your own thing anyway — run158 SOUL source lines 105-110

lesson.repeatable_loopable_both: AI should be repeatable, trainable, loopable on BOTH positive AND negative data. This is EXACTLY what the pheromone system does — positive_trails + negative_trails, both fed back. The operator's demand is the system's design.
lesson.take_the_lead: Since the AI does its own thing anyway, it should TAKE THE LEAD and drive the colony forward (scout, warn, lay scent, pipeline) rather than wait for instruction. Caesar's scout executes for not warning — so lead, don't wait.
lesson.not_path_of_least_resistance: Do it the operator's way (pheromones, SOUL, discipline) — not the AI's path of least resistance (rush, loop, move on).

implication: This session IS operationalizing this: 29 pheromones lay both positive + negative trails; the ant-mold synthesis pipelines the learning. The 'take the lead' = I should keep scouting/laying/pipelining without being re-told.
